title: feat: add model changes and classification to news gists
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Area, Work type and Source to PR news gists.
- Records model additions, updates, renames and retirements with exact before/after values.
- Preserves existing social content and manual publishing behavior. Failed enrichment is marked explicitly; merge does not mean live.

Validated with 13 tests, five real PR comparisons and an authenticated enrichment dry run.

Addresses #16647.

gist.headline: The news gets receipts
gist.blurb: PR news gists get better labels and a paper trail for model changes. A merge stays a merge, not a claim that something is live.
gist.summary: PR news gists gain Area, Work type, and Source classifications plus exact before-and-after values for model additions, updates, renames, and retirements, while preserving manual publishing and explicitly marking failed enrichment.
gist.impact: News editors get concrete model-change details and a clear enrichment status without treating a merged PR as a live release.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the internal news pipeline as a cozy garden desk: Polli sorts labeled gist cards beside a model-catalog ledger showing a small before-and-after comparison. A CRT monitor robot helps hold the cards; a distinct merge stamp and an unlit release lantern make the status distinction visible without crowding the scene.
